regime_context: Big Banks lead with high momentum, strong durability, and crowded positioning; Insurers are the sole challenger but no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, and the majority of themes are eligible, suggesting a broad trend-following environment with re-acceleration risks on any crowding unwind.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks rank #1, have high durability (0.78), and the absolute-trend gate is confirmed helpful for cutting drawdowns in this market. Despite crowding (z=1.56), staying with the eligible leader aligns with the one validated risk-control edge, while crowding flags a sizing caution — not a direction call. The trend-dominant regime is supported by broad rotation and positive gate history.
evidence: Durability bar high at 0.78 (Hurst mixed but trend-health robust)
Broad rotation (75% eligible) signals supportive regime breadth
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a sharp reversal if macro/credit sentiment sours (unscheduled surprise share is 1.0), and historic momentum has no alpha — the rank is a focus lens, not a forecast. Durability could evaporate in a risk-off event.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for 3 consecutive sessions, signaling trend break.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are ineligible (trend gate not passed), rank last (#15), with negative momentum score (-0.645) and zero breadth. The gate historically reduces drawdowns when respected, so avoiding ineligible themes provides risk control. A geopolitical shock is the main contrary risk, but without trend confirmation, underweight is warranted.
evidence: Durability bar very low at 0.25 (Hurst trend but weak regime health)
Absolute-trend gate validation supports avoiding ineligible themes
theses.dissent: Geopolitical surprise (dominant macro theme) could trigger a sharp gold rally, rapidly improving Gold Miners' trend metrics before a formal re-eligibility signal. The high unscheduled news share (1.0) makes such a spike plausible.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO crosses above its 200-day moving average and holds above it for a full week, signaling a potential re-entry into a trend-eligible regime.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
